lessons.observation: The consent orchestrator was intentionally limited to a schema and validator.
lessons.what_worked_or_failed: The fail-closed boundary worked, but the capability provided no direct public action.
lessons.root_cause_or_enabling_factor: V11 correctly prioritized architecture safety before runtime behavior.
lessons.product_change_made: Added a fixed-choice, device-only handoff planner that keeps runtime transfer disabled.
lessons.builder_prompt_system_change_made: Added a maturity progression rule requiring exact before/after capability classification.
lessons.future_candidate_selection_effect: Prefer the next safe maturity slice over either indefinite schema-only status or premature server activation.
lessons.future_testing_or_recovery_effect: Test both user utility and preserved closed boundaries.

lessons.observation: Dual progress can be asserted in prose without being enforced.
lessons.what_worked_or_failed: Templates clarify intent, but an ordinary release still needs an executable gate.
lessons.root_cause_or_enabling_factor: No product-specific validator linked both tracks to tests and artifacts.
lessons.product_change_made: Exposed the dual-track result in the protected owner control center.
lessons.builder_prompt_system_change_made: Added a deterministic fail-closed validator for both tracks and learning evidence.
lessons.future_candidate_selection_effect: Reject single-track ordinary release candidates before packaging.
lessons.future_testing_or_recovery_effect: Recovery releases must show whether both tracks advanced or document a permitted non-ordinary classification.

unresolved_learning_questions: Which portal will first independently accept a local import adapter for the handoff plan?
next_version_learning_priorities: Measure public comprehension without collecting plan contents.
Evaluate accessible QR export without enabling tracking or automatic transfer.
